# Dark Knight

Dark Knight is a Gotham-noir interface with deep blacks, Bat-signal gold accents and steel-blue details. Joker red is reserved for errors and unresolved links, H1 through H3 use a gold gradient, code shows gold keywords and green strings, and blockquotes carry a gold left bar with a faint glow. A softened light mode is included.

![Dark Knight screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jabaho9523/DarkKnightTheme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue

    name:   "Dark Knight"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

Reserve Joker red for errors and unresolved links, highlight H1–H3 with a gold gradient, style code with gold keywords and green strings, and mark blockquotes with a gold left bar and faint glow; include a softened light mode."
}
```
